summary: Iteration 17 frontend testing of /demo/supermarket CreatorBoostAI rewrite. Hero, start screen, 14-scene story arc, personalization, mobile, aliases (/demo/retail, /demo/c-store, /demo/grocery), homepage CTAs, navbar link, and backend smoke checks (TTS + share-demo) all pass. CRITICAL FORBIDDEN-VOCAB violation found: the global Navbar logo on every page (including /demo/supermarket) renders 'CreatorBoostAI™ + BodyIQ-AI™', so the strings 'BodyIQ' and 'BodyIQ-AI' appear in /demo/supermarket DOM body innerText. The Supermarket page itself (hero, start screen, scenes, narration, share module) is clean of all forbidden vocabulary — but the shared site Navbar wordmark still includes 'BodyIQ-AI™'.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 202 (Accepted) instead of 200 when Resend not configured; payload requires 'recipient_email' (not 'recipient'). 202 is functionally correct for async/accepted. Smoke check passes.

ui_bugs.issue: Brand logo on every page reads 'CreatorBoostAI™ + BodyIQ-AI™'. This puts the forbidden tokens 'BodyIQ' and 'BodyIQ-AI' into the user-visible DOM body innerText of /demo/supermarket (and /demo/retail, /demo/c-store, /demo/grocery). The iter-17 spec requires ZERO user-visible occurrences of these tokens on /demo/supermarket.
ui_bugs.selector: header brand link / Navbar logo span

action_items: Update /app/frontend/src/components/site/Navbar.jsx (and any shared Layout/Footer) to remove 'BodyIQ-AI™' from the visible brand wordmark on the Supermarket route — or globally rename to CreatorBoostAI-only — to satisfy the forbidden-vocabulary requirement.
Optionally also scrub 'BodyIQ-AI' from any aria-label/title attributes that surface in screen-reader DOM text, and from the page <title> if it contains it.
critical_code_review_comments: SupermarketDemoPage.jsx is 1272 lines — consider splitting SCENES + 14 stage components into /pages/supermarket/scenes/*.jsx to drop main file <700 lines.
useEffect with [scene, started] disables exhaustive-deps for speakScene; acceptable but noisy. Memoize speakScene with stable deps to avoid the disable.
ClosingStage hard-codes 6 closing bullets; consider exporting a shared CLOSING_BULLETS constant for reuse in marketing surfaces.
ShareModule constructs QR via api.qrserver.com with no fallback if the third-party is down — add an graceful state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 scenes, story arc order, hero copy, start screen, system-name list, personalization (?name=&company=), aliases, homepage CTAs, mobile (375px no horizontal overflow), TTS endpoint, and share-demo endpoint all verified working. The single remaining HIGH bug is the Navbar wordmark still containing 'BodyIQ-AI™'. Once that wordmark is removed from the Supermarket route the entire iter-17 spec is satisfied. Note: the SupermarketDemoPage.jsx body itself contains zero forbidden tokens (only one allowed JS code comment at line 617 saying 'no behavioral signals' which is non-user-visible).
rca of the issue: Iter-17 rewrite scrubbed the SupermarketDemoPage.jsx component thoroughly, but the shared global Layout/Navbar (rendered above the demo page) still uses the old dual-brand wordmark 'CreatorBoostAI™ + BodyIQ-AI™'. document.body.innerText therefore still contains the forbidden tokens on every demo route. Fix: edit /app/frontend/src/components/site/Navbar.jsx (and any logo SVG/text it imports) so the brand on the Supermarket route renders CreatorBoostAI only — either by removing the '+ BodyIQ-AI™' span unconditionally, or by route-conditional rendering (hide on pathname.startsWith('/demo/')).
